method: Read official documentation, original paper and creator pages; no demo video analysis or preset download.

sources.title: Adobe Animating text
sources.technical_basis: Text animators/selectors, grouping, transform, path and per-character 3D primitives.

sources.title: Kinetic Typography Engine, Lee/Forlizzi/Hudson, UIST 2002
sources.technical_basis: Factored behavior composition, expressive temporal typography, waveform manipulation.

sources.title: GSAP Staggers
sources.technical_basis: each/amount/from/grid and function-based stagger.

sources.title: Fluent 2 Motion
sources.technical_basis: Functional motion, duration, distance and easing; UI guidance rather than video reading-speed evidence.

sources.title: Mister Horse Animation Composer
sources.technical_basis: Discoverable titles, callouts and editable preset applications; no vendor preset copied.

sources.title: GSAP SplitText
sources.technical_basis: Split lines/words/chars, font/reflow, cleanup and accessibility caveats.

sources.title: Remotion Animating properties
sources.technical_basis: Frame-driven animation; avoid wall-clock CSS transitions when rendering.

sources.title: Remotion spring
sources.technical_basis: Physical spring controls and optional overshoot clamp.

sources.title: Remotion interpolate
sources.technical_basis: Keyframe interpolation, easing and explicit extrapolation clamp.

sources.title: Unicode UAX29
sources.technical_basis: Extended grapheme clusters, canonical equivalence and segmentation boundaries.

sources.title: ECMA402 Segmenter
sources.technical_basis: Intl.Segmenter grapheme/word/sentence; locale-dependent boundaries.

sources.title: W3C Animation from interactions
sources.technical_basis: SC2.3.3 interaction-triggered motion and disabling nonessential animation.

sources.title: W3C Pause Stop Hide
sources.technical_basis: Conditional SC2.2.2 pause/stop/hide requirements.

sources.title: WCAG22 Flash thresholds
sources.technical_basis: SC2.3.1 flash thresholds, not a universal frequency-only guarantee.

sources.title: Three.js TextGeometry
sources.technical_basis: One geometry per supplied string; extrusion/bevel parameters; separate grouping/shaping needed.

sources.title: Three.js FontLoader
sources.technical_basis: Font addon loading and format pipeline.

sources.title: Three.js PerspectiveCamera
sources.technical_basis: FOV/aspect/near/far projection; focus does not implement DoF by itself.

sources.title: Three.js Sprite
sources.technical_basis: Camera-facing plane; Sprite cannot cast shadows.

sources.title: Adobe Extrude text and shapes
sources.technical_basis: Current 2026 Advanced3D and C4D renderers support extrusion; renderer material differences.

sources.title: Maxon Text Object 2026
sources.technical_basis: Letters/words/lines/all grouping and pivots.

sources.title: Maxon Text Object Properties 2026
sources.technical_basis: Depth/subdivision; overlapping font paths and kerning limitations.

sources.title: Maxon Effectors 2026
sources.technical_basis: Transform, step, formula, random, delay, spline, fields; applicability varies.

sources.title: Maxon MoGraph Basics
sources.technical_basis: Cloner distributions, spline, sound/field-driven transforms.

sources.title: Maxon Extrude Object Properties
sources.technical_basis: Extrusion direction/subdivision/normals and hierarchical option.

sources.title: Blender String to Curves 4.2
sources.technical_basis: Instances of character curves; full document fetch returned402 during research.

sources.title: Blender Sample Curve 4.5
sources.technical_basis: Position/tangent/normal sampling; full document fetch returned402.

sources.title: Blender Text Properties 3.6
sources.technical_basis: Extrusion/taper/bevel principle; old version and full fetch unavailable.

sources.title: Mister Horse Text Presets
sources.technical_basis: Catalog taxonomy separates effects and line/word/character transitions.

sources.title: Mister Horse Line Transitions
sources.technical_basis: Property families include position, mask, scale/tracking and typewrite; these are listing categories, not tested assets.

sources.title: AEJuice Text Animation Presets
sources.technical_basis: Listing names expose transform properties, grouping and easing separately.

sources.title: Motion Bro
sources.technical_basis: Shared scene controls and aspect-ratio adaptation; no specific typography pack execution verified.

sources.title: Motion Array In Control Kinetic Typography
sources.technical_basis: Creator listing for an editable kinetic-type template; text read, project not executed.

sources.title: Premiumilk Kinetic Neon Typo Pack
sources.technical_basis: Creator listing distinguishes appearance, loop duration and output aspect ratios.

sources.title: ProductionCrate Text Animator
sources.technical_basis: Creator groups include glitch, fly-in, slide and spin; script not downloaded.

sources.title: Apple Motion Sequence Text
sources.technical_basis: Configurable text sequencing behavior separates parameters, direction, speed and units.

sources.title: Kielm Space Type Generator
sources.technical_basis: Original creator exposes spatial typography module names; individual algorithms and exports not tested.

sources.title: School of Motion Kinetic Typography Part 2
sources.technical_basis: Read article/transcript about choosing motion from spoken meaning, markers and reusable compositions.

sources.title: Kinetic Typography Diffusion Model, ECCV 2024
sources.technical_basis: Abstract distinguishes about 600K generated videos from 584 authored templates; no dataset redistributed.

sources.title: Dynamic Typography
sources.technical_basis: Abstract discusses semantic deformation and shape/legibility preservation in its specific research method.

sources.title: FIT Introduction to Kinetic Typography syllabus
sources.technical_basis: Semantic motion selection and animation principles; historical software/delivery advice not adopted.

sources.title: Carbon Typography Style Strategies
sources.technical_basis: Productive versus expressive typography informs an authored video-domain analogy; not a video benchmark.

sources.title: Dstl A Bite-Sized Guide to Visualising Data
sources.technical_basis: Scale, area and perspective can change data interpretation; numeric-text rules are an authored application.

scope: Technical documentation, creator catalog text and original research. No commercial template assets, source code, fonts or datasets included. No claim to have watched every demo.
